subject: Weekly revenue submission: lane-by-lane readiness & escalation play
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Zoe Lambert <zoe.lambert@acme.com>, Finance PMO <finance-pmo@enterprise.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly revenue submission: lane-by-lane readiness & escalation play

Team —

Quick reminder: weekly submission is due EOD tomorrow. I want a short, lane-by-lane readiness update in SFDC and a consolidated upload to the attached weekly_numbers_template.csv. Key asks: 

- For each open opportunity, set: current probability, next-step (concrete milestone), expected signed date, legal owner, and procurement status.
- Tag any deals that need an operational escalation with the label: escalation-ops.
- For deals stuck in procurement or redlines, attach a single-page summary (procurement_redline_summary.pdf style) and flag as 'procurement-blocker'.

Please prioritize accurate dates over optimistic best-case dates — finance needs defensible inputs for the cash model. If you expect variance > 20% vs the number you submitted last week, call it out in the comments column.

We will run a 30-minute readout at 4:00 PM PT tomorrow to review lanes that have > $100k at risk. Agenda below. If you cannot make it, update the sheet and add short notes so the call can triage without you.

Attachments: weekly_numbers_template.csv

Agenda (prelim):
- 4:00–4:05 — Quick status and attendance
- 4:05–4:15 — Lane owners present high-risk deals (owner, blocker, ask)
- 4:15–4:25 — Procurement/legal escalations (who owns outreach)
- 4:25–4:30 — Action items, owners, and deadlines

If any SLAs or enterprise procurement issues require leadership escalation, put them in the procurement-blocker folder and CC Finance PMO.

Thanks —
Michael
Michael Grant
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly revenue submission: lane-by-lane readiness & escalation play

Thanks, Michael — will do. Quick notes:

- I'll update SFDC by EOD tomorrow. Two deals (ACME-194, ACME-203) are held by procurement pending a contract redline; attaching a short summary.
- For ACME-203, procurement asked for a term on data retention; legal is drafting language today.

Attached: procurement_redline_summary.pdf

Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 14:58:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly revenue submission: lane-by-lane readiness & escalation play

Michael — quick question on the probability buckets so our AE team aligns:

- For the sheet, are we using: 20% (early pipeline), 50% (qualified / buyer engaged), 75% (negotiation/PO in progress), 95% (legal signoff pending) as the working thresholds?
- Do we treat 'partner approval' delays as procurement blockers or as separate gating items? (I suggest procurement-blocker for anything that requires legal/procurement outreach outside of our sales motions).

If we lock these thresholds now I'll batch-update deals that R. owns and tag others for owner confirmation. Also adding a short doc with recommended definitions to the drive link.

Subject: Re: Weekly revenue submission: lane-by-lane readiness & escalation play

Thanks for the quick responses. Agreed on thresholds — use the Rishi buckets (20/50/75/95) and mark anything requiring partner/legal/procurement outreach as procurement-blocker.

Updated agenda for tomorrow's readout (4:00 PM PT):
- Roll call and lanes (4:00–4:06)
- High-risk deals (each owner: 60s status, blocker, ask) (4:06–4:18)
- Procurement/legal escalations — owners and outreach plan (4:18–4:25)
- Final actions and deadlines (4:25–4:30)

Action items now: 
- Lauren: upload the template with ACME-194/203 notes + attach procurement_redline_summary.pdf by EOD tomorrow.
- Rishi: publish the probability threshold doc to the drive and batch any deals you own for initial alignment.
- Neha: ensure Finance PMO has the latest cash assumptions once the sheet is uploaded.

If anyone expects to be out or wants to handoff their lane coverage, ping me directly. I'll circulate the meeting notes + consolidated sheet after the readout.

Michael
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com
